citation.title: Parametric dependencies of locked mode thresholds in KSTAR L-mode plasmas
citation.authors: Yang, S.M.; Park, J.-K.; Na, Y.S.; In, Y.; Hahn, H.; et al.

topic: Empirical n=1 and n=2 error-field locked-mode thresholds in KSTAR L-mode/ohmic plasmas. The paper covers dependence on density, rotation and toroidal field. It interprets the density dependence through the LOC-to-SOC transition and uses IPEC resonant and overlap fields.
own_question: How do KSTAR locked-mode error-field thresholds depend on density, toroidal field and toroidal harmonic?
actual_method_and_evidence: The authors ramped IVCC 3D fields until a locked mode penetrated. Penetration was identified with magnetic probes, ECE/ECEI and CES rotation. CES profiles needed NBI or NBI blips. Thresholds were converted with IPEC. Power-law fits were made on a multi-year database. The study gives no CES nowcasting, no temperature estimation and no BES-based prediction.
input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. CES rotation was used offline for profile interpretation. The paper reports no report-arrival timing.
validation_if_relevant: Not applicable. The paper uses regression fits on a pooled database and has no held-out validation.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite this paper as evidence for CES temperature nowcasting or for its latency.
Do not use it to infer that ECEI predicts Ti.
Do not cite it for KSTAR2022 pedestal-top chord behavior.
Do not treat its LOC/SOC interpretation or proposed scaling modification as demonstrated physics.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Exclude. The topic is MHD locked-mode thresholds, which does not match our causal CES-report nowcasting framing. Its one marginal point is that ohmic KSTAR rotation-profile measurement required NBI. That point is better sourced elsewhere and should not be generalized.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
